title: Onsemi reportedly in talks to buy AI power-chip startup Ferric for close to US$1 billion
description: Onsemi has been discussing an acquisition of Ferric, a New York-based maker of integrated voltage regulators for AI chips, for close to US$1 billion, The Information reported on October 27, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Powertech shifts to advanced packaging as AI demand drives growth
description: Rising demand for high-end AI chips is accelerating Powertech's transformation into an advanced packaging strategic partner. Powertech said its utilization rate exceeded 90% in the third quarter of 2026 and is expected to rise further in the fourth quarter as revenue grows, putting the company on track for record annual revenue.

title: Rokid launches full-color AI glasses with microLED display
description: Chinese smart-glasses maker Rokid unveiled its full-color AI glasses, Rokid Color, in Hangzhou on October 27, alongside the second-generation Rokid Glasses 2 and the Rokid Ring smart interaction wearable. The Rokid Color features a full-color microLED optical engine and is available starting at CNY4,999 (US$750).

title: Microsoft rides AI boom as Copilot takes off leaving white-collar jobs in jeopardy
description: Microsoft’s Copilot 365 AI platform is rapidly gaining traction among Australia’s biggest employers, as hopes of a productivity boom clash with worries over job cuts.

title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can’t use
description: It’s almost like Google’s got something to prove after taking a break from releasing new frontier AI models earlier this year.
